title: OPS-BUGFIX — cmdStatus: filter dry-run posts from gate count
description: cmdStatus() in cmd-management.ts uses posts.length which includes dry-run posts (5 entries) instead of real posts (2). Apply DRY_METHODS filter so /status shows 2/30 instead of 5/30. Same pattern as gate generator fix.

tasks.title: Add dry-run filter to cmdStatus() gate calculation
tasks.description: In cmdStatus(): after loading posts from manual-posts.jsonl, filter out dry-runs using DRY_METHODS=['browser-post-dry','batch-browser-dry','dry']. Use filtered list for totalPosts, paceNeeded, urgency calculations.
